description.value: Park Inn by Radisson Osoyoos is a contemporary hotel in the heart of Osoyoos town centre, positioned in Canada's only desert region at the southern tip of the Okanagan Valley. The property features a seasonal outdoor pool and hot tub, BBQ and picnic areas set against desert landscapes, and mountain and pool-view rooms. With 24-hour reception and free on-site parking (including accessible spaces), it is a practical overnight base for cyclists touring the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms the OSM address (9130 Main Street, Osoyoos, BC V0H 1V2) and phone number exactly. The amenities page and front page explicitly list free WiFi, vending machines, continental breakfast, and laundry (as an extra service on the booking page). No mention of secure bike storage or bike-specific staff procedures anywhere on the site; the booking page lists 'Bike Rental' as a filter checkbox but this appears to be a generic booking-template option (the same page also lists 'Hotel Rome' and 'Hotel London' as branches, and shows placeholder '0+' room counts), so it is not treated as confirmed evidence.
concerns: The booking page lists 'Hotel Rome' and 'Hotel London' as sibling branches alongside the Osoyoos property, and shows '0+' placeholder values for all room-count statistics — the website appears to use a generic third-party booking template that may not accurately reflect this property's actual available services (e.g., the 'Bike Rental' checkbox should not be treated as confirmed).

The website (parkinnbyradissonosoyoos.com) is not the official Radisson Hotels brand site; it appears to be an independently operated property website, which may mean some listed amenities or branding details diverge from the chain standard.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel with an active website confirming its address, phone, and amenities. Straightforward inclusion as accommodation for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Continental breakfast is listed as complimentary on the amenities page, which could be relevant to cyclists needing an early meal, but no evidence of early-start or packed-lunch options was found.

Laundry.detail: Listed as an available extra service on the booking page

Vending machines.detail: Front page states: 'Vending machines are available in convenient locations.'

Device charging.detail: Mountain view room description mentions 'plenty of USB ports.'

wow_evidence: seasonal outdoor pool and hot tub, BBQ and picnic areas set against desert landscapes

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: Park Inn by Radisson is economy-midscale; Osoyoos shoulder ~$130-180 (peak much higher) - Upscale overbands shoulder rates
